notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Sends a push notification to people. Their phones are found automatically via the user signed in to the Companion app.

persons.description: Who gets the notification. Empty = everyone with the app.

set_report.description: Stores the latest report of an agent (e.g. the energy coach) in its sensor so dashboards can show it.
